founded_year.quote: 2000 The start: the first pan-European exchange, Euronext, is born Merger of the Amsterdam, Brussels and Paris exchanges to create Euronext N.V., the first pan-European exchange.

history.zh: 2000年阿姆斯特丹/布鲁塞尔/巴黎三所合并成立Euronext（首个泛欧交易所）；2001年收购LIFFE衍生品交易所并首次IPO（巴黎/阿姆斯特丹/布鲁塞尔三地同时挂牌）；2002年并入葡萄牙里斯本-波尔图交易所（成为Euronext Lisbon）；2007年与纽约证券交易所对等合并成NYSE Euronext；2013年ICE收购NYSE Euronext；2014年ICE保留LIFFE、将大陆欧洲业务拆分重新IPO为独立的Euronext N.V.（此后集团历史续接现在的法人实体）；2017年推出自有交易平台Optiq；2018年收购爱尔兰证券交易所（成为Euronext Dublin）；2019年收购Oslo Børs VPS（挪威交易所+挪威中央证券存管机构）；2020年收购丹麦中央证券存管机构VP Securities；2021年完成收购Borsa Italiana集团（米兰并入，同时成立跨国CSD网络Euronext Securities）；2023-2024年清算业务分阶段从LCH SA迁移至集团自有CCP Euronext Clearing（现货2023年11月、衍生品2024年9月完成）；2025年宣布并完成对希腊雅典交易所（ATHEX）的换股收购（成为第八个市场，但尚未并入统一规则手册与Optiq平台，计划2027年6月完成技术迁移）；同年9月Euronext N.V.自身股票纳入法国CAC 40指数
history.en: 2000: merger of Amsterdam, Brussels and Paris exchanges forms Euronext (first pan-European exchange). 2001: acquires LIFFE and completes first IPO (listed simultaneously in Paris/Amsterdam/Brussels). 2002: merges with the Portuguese exchange (becomes Euronext Lisbon). 2007: merger of equals with NYSE, forming NYSE Euronext. 2013: ICE acquires NYSE Euronext. 2014: ICE keeps LIFFE and spins off the continental European operations as a newly independent, re-IPO'd Euronext N.V. (the group's history continues under this legal entity). 2017: launches proprietary trading platform Optiq. 2018: acquires the Irish Stock Exchange (becomes Euronext Dublin). 2019: acquires Oslo Børs VPS (Norwegian exchange + Norwegian CSD). 2020: acquires VP Securities, the Danish CSD. 2021: completes acquisition of the Borsa Italiana Group (Milan joins; the cross-border CSD network Euronext Securities is launched). 2023-2024: clearing migrates in phases from LCH SA to the Group's own CCP, Euronext Clearing (cash markets November 2023, derivatives markets September 2024). 2025: announces and completes a share-exchange acquisition of the Athens Stock Exchange (ATHEX), becoming the eighth market — not yet integrated into the harmonised rulebook or Optiq, migration targeted for June 2027; in the same year (September 2025) Euronext N.V.'s own share joins the French CAC 40 Index

regulator.en: No single regulator — each of the seven Market Undertakings is supervised by, and governed under the law of, its own jurisdiction: Euronext Amsterdam (Netherlands, AFM/DNB), Euronext Brussels (Belgium, FSMA/BNB), Euronext Paris (France, AMF), Euronext Dublin (Ireland, Central Bank of Ireland), Euronext Lisbon (Portugal, CMVM), Borsa Italiana (Italy, CONSOB), Oslo Børs (Norway, Finanstilsynet); regulators in six countries have established a coordination mechanism for cross-market supervisory matters. This is the most fundamental structural difference from every single-jurisdiction exchange sampled so far in this project

core_laws.zh: 无单一核心法律——七个市场运营实体各自适用本国转化MiFID II（欧盟金融工具市场指令）后的国内法：荷兰《金融监督法》（Wet op het financieel toezicht）第5:26条、比利时2017年11月21日《金融工具市场基础设施法》、法国《货币与金融法典》第L.421-2条、葡萄牙2007年357-C号法令等；MiFID II/MiFIR是各国国内法背后共同的欧盟层级立法基础
core_laws.en: No single core law — each of the seven Market Undertakings operates under its own country's national implementation of MiFID II (the EU Markets in Financial Instruments Directive): the Netherlands' Financial Supervision Act (Wet op het financieel toezicht) Article 5:26, Belgium's Law of 21 November 2017 on market infrastructures, France's Monetary and Financial Code Article L.421-2, Portugal's Decree-Law 357-C/2007, etc.; MiFID II/MiFIR is the shared EU-level legislative basis behind each national law

foreign_ownership_limit.zh: 欧盟《资本自由流动》框架下，七个市场均无针对外资持股比例的集团统一上限；法国、意大利等部分国家对国防、能源、通信、媒体等战略性行业设有「黄金权力」(golden power) 外资安全审查机制，属国家安全审查而非普遍持股上限，其余行业外资准入与本国投资者一致。
foreign_ownership_limit.en: Under the EU free-movement-of-capital framework there is no group-wide foreign-ownership cap across the seven markets; France, Italy and some other countries operate sectoral "golden power" foreign-investment screening for strategically sensitive industries (defence, energy, telecoms, media, etc.) — a national-security review rather than a general shareholding ceiling — while foreign access in all other sectors is on par with domestic investors.

disclosure_requirements.zh: 发行人须遵守欧盟法律（透明指令）规定的披露与报告义务，向市场提供必要信息以保障投资者透明与市场的公允有序；具体含及时发布定期财务信息（年度与半年度报告，适用时经审计），以及持续披露可能影响证券定价的重大信息。规则手册统一要求发行人应平等、及时地向所有证券持有人提供其行使权利所需信息。
disclosure_requirements.en: Issuers must comply with the disclosure and reporting obligations under Union law (Transparency Directive) to ensure investor transparency and market integrity, providing the market with all necessary information; specifically this includes the timely publication of periodic financial information (annual and half-yearly reports, audited where applicable) and the ongoing disclosure of material information that may affect the pricing of their securities. The rulebook uniformly requires that an issuer shall make all information necessary for holders to exercise their rights available to all holders equally and in a timely manner.

sources.title: Euronext Rule Book Book I - Harmonised Rules（Rule 61003/2 持续披露义务）

disclosure_requirements.quote: An Issuer shall provide the market all necessary information to enable holders of its Securities to exercise their rights. This requirement includes, inter alia, the need to publish periodic financial information (including annual and half-yearly reports), audited where applicable, in a timely manner, in accordance with Union Law or National Regulations.

investor_protection.zh: 投资者保护主要由各成员国法律与本国监管机构（如法国 AMF、荷兰 AFM、意大利 CONSOB 等）依欧盟 MiFID II 与《投资者补偿计划指令》(ICS) 实施，各市场设有法定投资者补偿基金（如法国 FGDR、荷兰 Beleggerscompensatie-fonds、比利时 Fonds de protection des dépôts et des instruments financiers 等）；交易所层面通过统一的持续披露义务、市场监控与会员纪律间接保护投资者，但本所并非独立的投资者保护机构。
investor_protection.en: Investor protection is primarily delivered by each member state's law and its home regulator (e.g. AMF in France, AFM in the Netherlands, CONSOB in Italy) under EU MiFID II and the Investor Compensation Scheme Directive (ICS): each market has a statutory investor-compensation fund (e.g. FGDR in France, Beleggerscompensatie-fonds in the Netherlands, the Belgian Fonds de protection des dépôts et des instruments financiers, etc.). At the exchange level, investors are indirectly protected through the harmonised continuing-disclosure obligations, market surveillance and member discipline, but the exchange itself is not a standalone investor-protection authority.

opening_mechanism.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening uncrossing）：订单累积期内只录入订单不成交，撮合算法启动时中央订单簿短暂冻结，以能实现最大成交量的理论开盘价定价；若无法撮合，则以主交易时段第一笔成交价作为开盘价
opening_mechanism.en: Opening uncrossing: during the order-accumulation period orders are entered but not matched; when the matching algorithm runs the Central Order Book is briefly frozen and the opening price is set at the level that maximises matched volume; if no match occurs, the price of the first trade in the main trading session becomes the opening price

sources.title: Notice n°4-01 Trading Manual

opening_mechanism.quote: At the opening, the Euronext Trading Platform seeks to match orders for each Security (the "opening uncrossing"). At the beginning of the price determination phase for a Security the Central Order Book is frozen momentarily ... while the matching algorithm is running. The opening price is the last theoretical opening price calculated before matching.

closing_mechanism.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing uncrossing）：机制与开盘集合竞价相同；收盘参考价通常即收盘集合竞价成交价，若集合竞价未产生成交价则退而采用主交易时段最后成交价
closing_mechanism.en: Closing uncrossing: the same mechanism as the opening uncrossing; the closing reference price is generally the closing-uncrossing price, falling back to the last traded price of the main session if the uncrossing produces no price

closing_mechanism.quote: Except for certain Securities where the closing reference price results from alternative methods described in Article 5.4, the closing reference price for Securities which are traded continuously shall in general be the price defined by the closing uncrossing. If no price is issued at the closing uncrossing, the closing reference price shall in general be the last traded price during the main trading session.

matching_principle.zh: 严格价格优先，同价位按时间优先（strict price/time priority）；对未公开披露的订单类型（大宗订单Large-in-Scale、中间价订单Mid-Point）另有独立的规模/时间优先规则
matching_principle.en: Strict price priority, with strict time priority at the same price level; orders exempted from pre-trade transparency (Large-in-Scale orders, Mid-Point orders) follow separate size/time priority rules

matching_principle.quote: Orders in the Central Order Book shall be executed according to strict price priority. Orders at the same price are ranked and executed according to strict time priority

type.zh: 双层价格区间机制——动态区间（dynamic collar，基准价为逐笔更新的最新成交价）+ 静态区间（static collar，基准价为当日开盘价或前日收盘参考价），触及阈值即触发预约期（reservation period），不是直接拒单的固定百分比涨跌停
type.en: Two-layer price-range mechanism — dynamic collars (reference price updated after each trade) plus static collars (reference price is the day's opening price or the previous day's closing reference price); breaching a threshold triggers a reservation period rather than flatly rejecting orders as with a fixed daily limit

type.quote: Dynamic and static collars constitute the first and second layers of Euronext's circuit-breaker mechanism, respectively. The dynamic reference price and the static reference price are used to calculate both collars. The dynamic reference price changes throughout the trading day after each trade, with the last traded price becoming the new reference. The static reference price remains the same during all trading sessions unless it is manually changed by Euronext's Market Operations team.

main_board.zh: 动态区间：普通股±5%，旗舰指数成分股±3%；静态区间：普通股±10%（对照前收盘价），旗舰指数成分股±8%——「旗舰指数」按fee guide定义为CAC 40/AEX/BEL 20/PSI/SBF 120/AMX/ISEQ 20/OBX/FTSE MIB成分股
main_board.en: Dynamic collars: ±5% for ordinary shares, ±3% for flagship-index constituents; static collars: ±10% (vs previous close) for ordinary shares, ±8% for flagship-index constituents — "flagship index" per the fee guide covers constituents of CAC 40/AEX/BEL 20/PSI/SBF 120/AMX/ISEQ 20/OBX/FTSE MIB

volatility_interruption.zh: 预约期（reservation period）：连续交易阶段理论撮合价触及适用阈值即触发预约期，至少持续3分钟；因动态区间触发的首次预约后，恢复交易有两种方式——由Euronext评估市场情况后人工设定参数，或按预约期内报价自动更新动态区间后自动撮合恢复；若自动方式仍在同方向再次触发预约，是否进一步调整区间/参考价须再经Euronext评估市场情况后决定
volatility_interruption.en: Reservation period: triggered when the theoretical matching price during continuous trading breaches the applicable thresholds, lasting at least 3 minutes; upon the first reservation caused by a dynamic collar breach, resumption may follow either a manual process (parameters set by Euronext after assessing market conditions) or an automatic process with updated dynamic collars; if the automatic process is breached again in the same direction, any further adjustment to the collars or reference price is decided by Euronext only after a fresh market assessment

sources.title: Notice n°4-01 Trading Manual

volatility_interruption.quote: Euronext initiates a reservation period if, during the continuous trading phase, the theoretical price at which a security can be traded breaches the applicable thresholds. The reservation period shall last at least 3 minutes. ... Upon the first reservation caused by dynamic collars breach, the attempt to resume trading may take place following two possible processes depending on the type of securities: - Manual process with parameters determined by Euronext after an assessment of market conditions; - Automatic process with updated dynamic collars using the interval for uncrossing process mentioned in the Appendix. If upon this first trading resumption attempt, the updated collars are breached in the same direction (i.e. second consecutive downwards or second consecutive upwards reservation), any decision to adjust the collars and the reference price before resuming continuous trading will be made after an assessment of market conditions.

opening_mechanism.zh: Call Phase（开盘集合竞价累积阶段）结束后由撮合引擎运行揭示（uncrossing）算法；若开盘时出现价格倒挂（买价高于卖价）或买卖同价（choice price），撮合引擎将计算能实现最大成交量的价格并自动执行相应成交，成交价格不劣于原始委托价，未成交的买卖盘继续留在市场
opening_mechanism.en: After the Call Phase (order-accumulation period) ends, the matching engine runs an uncrossing algorithm; where backwardation (bids higher than offers) or choice prices (bids equal to offers) exist at Market Open, the engine calculates the price at which maximum volume can be traded and automatically executes trades accordingly, at a price no worse than the order's entered price, with any untraded bids/offers remaining in the market

opening_mechanism.quote: Where backwardation (bids higher than offers) or choice prices (bids equal to offers) exist at Market Open, the matching engine will run an uncrossing algorithm to calculate the price at which the maximum volume can be traded and automatically executes trades accordingly: any orders executed in this way will be traded at a price equal to or better than that at which they were entered and any untraded bids and/or offers will remain in the market.

closing_mechanism.zh: 每日结算价（Daily Settlement Price, DSP）机制：期货合约按『中央订单簿价格法』（结算时点前不少于2分钟的『结算区间』内的成交价/成交量加权均价/买卖盘中间价/公允价值，按优先顺序取值）或『官方收盘价法』二者之一确定，具体某合约采用哪种方法见Annexe One；其中股票期货（所有市场）与股指期货（所有市场，但股指总回报期货与股指分红期货除外）统一采用官方收盘价法，其余期货合约采用中央订单簿价格法
closing_mechanism.en: Daily Settlement Price (DSP) mechanism: for futures contracts, DSP is set by either the Central Order Book price method (a hierarchy of last traded price / volume-weighted average / mid-BBO / fair value, calculated over a Settlement Range of no less than 2 minutes before the settlement time) or the official closing price method — which applies to which contract is set out in Annexe One; Single Stock Futures (all markets) and Index Futures (all markets, except Index Total Return Futures and Index Dividend Futures) uniformly use the official closing price method, while other futures contracts use the Central Order Book price method

closing_mechanism.quote: The Daily Settlement Price for Futures Contracts is calculated using one of the following two methods: (a) Central Order Book price method ...; or (b) official closing price method ... Daily Settlement price (TP2.2): the Official Closing Price method is used for Single Stock Futures Contracts (all markets) and for Index Futures (all markets) except Index Total Return Futures and Index Dividend Futures. The Central Order Book method is used for all other Futures Contracts.

matching_principle.zh: 逐合约设定为『价格/时间优先』或『按比例分配（Pro-rata）』二者之一（具体见Annexe One逐合约对照表）：价格/时间优先——同一合约/交割月/组合中，最高买价与最低卖价优先，同价位按接受时间先后排序；按比例分配——最优价位的全部买卖盘按比例算法分配成交量，具体细节见Annex 3
matching_principle.en: Each contract is assigned either "Price/Time priority" or "Pro-rata priority" (see Annexe One for the per-contract mapping): Price/Time priority — within the same contract/delivery month/strategy, the highest bid and lowest offer take priority, ranked by acceptance time at the same price; Pro-rata priority — all bids/offers at the best price in the same contract/delivery month/strategy trade according to a pro-rata algorithm, detailed in Annex 3

matching_principle.quote: The following order prioritisation criteria will determine trade priority. ... (a) Price/Time priority: (i) best price. A buy order at the highest price and a sell order at the lowest price has priority over orders in the same contract/delivery month/strategy; and (ii) oldest time-stamp. ... (b) Pro-rata priority: (i) best price ...; (ii) pro-rata. All buy orders at the highest price and all sell orders at the lowest price in the same contract/delivery month/strategy are traded in accordance with the pro-rata algorithm

order_types.zh: 限价单（Limit）、市价单（Market）、止损单（Stop，含Stop Limit/Stop Market两类，不参与Call Phase）三大类，可附加Day/Good Till Cancelled(GTC)/Good Till Date(GTD)/Immediate or Cancel(IOC)/Fill or Kill(FOK)/Minimum Quantity(MQ)六种有效期/执行方式设计；具体哪些订单功能适用于某一合约按市场/合约而异，见Annexe One逐合约对照表（Part II）
order_types.en: Three main order types: Limit Order, Market Order, and Stop Order (Stop Limit / Stop Market, not participating in the Call Phase), which can carry six validity/execution designations: Day, Good Till Cancelled (GTC), Good Till Date (GTD), Immediate or Cancel (IOC), Fill or Kill (FOK), and Minimum Quantity (MQ); which order functionality applies to a given contract varies by market/contract, see Annexe One's per-contract table (Part II)

tick_size.zh: 由Optiq的『Tick Table（跳动点表）』机制统一定义：每张Tick Table含一组按价格区间分档的跳动点位，并为Front Month（最活跃到期月）及到期日更近的合约（日度/周度）另设一个跳动点位收窄比例；Tick Table按合约（Contract）分配，每日通过统一的参考数据文件下发，同一Tick Table可被多个合约及多种交易机制（COB/Wholesale/RFC）共用；不同产品线（股指期货期权/固定收益迷你期货/商品期货）跳动点位差异很大，例如固定收益迷你期货（BTP/OAT/Bund/BONO）中央订单簿跳动点位为票面值0.01%（对应€2.5/张，其中BTP 30年期为0.02%/€5），大宗交易设施（LiS）跳动点位更细至0.001%（€0.25/张）
tick_size.en: Tick sizes are defined uniformly via Optiq's "Tick Table" mechanism: each Tick Table contains a set of price ranges with associated tick sizes, plus a narrower tick-size ratio for the Front Month (most active expiry) and expiries closer to maturity (daily/weekly); a Tick Table is assigned per Contract and distributed daily via a common reference-data file, and one Tick Table may be shared across multiple contracts and market mechanisms (COB/Wholesale/RFC). Tick sizes vary greatly across product lines — e.g. Fixed Income Mini-futures (BTP/OAT/Bund/BONO) have a Central Order Book tick of 0.01% of par value (€2.5 per contract; 0.02%/€5 for BTP 30yr), with the Large-in-Scale (LiS) facility ticking finer at 0.001% (€0.25 per contract)

contract_specs_note.en: The derivatives business comprises three product lines (already listed in the Products chapter): (1) Equity & Index Derivatives — futures/options on flagship indices (AEX/BEL 20/PSI/FTSE MIB/OBX/CAC 40 etc.) and single stocks across the Amsterdam/Brussels/Lisbon/Milan/Oslo/Paris markets, with contract multipliers and expiry cycles (monthly/quarterly/half-yearly) varying by product; (2) Fixed Income Derivatives — launched September 2025, mini-futures on Italian BTP (10yr/30yr), French OAT (10yr), German Bund (10yr) and Spanish BONO (10yr), all with a uniform €25,000 notional contract size, cash-settled, with the settlement price = Cheapest-to-Deliver (CTD) bond price / Conversion Factor — but **all listed on the Milan (Borsa Italiana IDEM) market only**, despite underlyings spanning four sovereign issuers — a structural case of "pan-European underlying, single-jurisdiction listing venue"; (3) Commodity Derivatives (incl. power) — agricultural futures (Milling Wheat/Rapeseed/Corn/Durum Wheat etc., Paris market), freight futures, and power futures (listed on the Amsterdam market, with the expiry settlement price referencing the average spot price published by Nord Pool — Nord Pool itself, acquired in 2020, acts as the price-publishing "issuer" of the underlying rather than a separate trading venue). On clearing: Euronext Clearing completed its takeover of all Euronext derivatives markets in September 2024, replacing the previous CCP LCH S.A., the final step of the group's multi-asset clearing consolidation

type.zh: 与现货市场类似的双层价格区间机制——动态区间（Dynamic Collar，基准价为动态参考价DCRP，随行情实时更新）+ 静态区间（Static Collar，基准价为静态参考价SCRP，日内一般不变，但交易所可人工调整），触及区间边界即拒单或转入预约（reservation），不是直接的固定百分比涨跌停；此外还有专门应对短时极端行情的Future Spike Protection（收窄区间但仍允许在合理范围内继续交易）与Future Limit Interruption Protection（触发后直接转入预约期）两种叠加保护
type.en: A two-layer price-band mechanism similar to the cash market — dynamic collars (reference price is the Dynamic Collar Reference Price, DCRP, updated in real time) plus static collars (reference price is the Static Collar Reference Price, SCRP, generally unchanged intraday but adjustable by the Exchange); breaching either band results in order rejection or a reservation, not a flat percentage limit-up/down. Two further overlapping safeguards specifically target short, extreme price moves: Future Spike Protection (narrows the band while still allowing trading within a reasonable range) and Future Limit Interruption Protection (triggers a reservation directly)

Trading safeguards on the Euronext markets（Derivatives trading safeguards 一节）

type.quote: Throughout each trading session and during the Call Phase, dynamic collars will be calculated to define the spread of acceptable prices for trading a given Instrument ... the dynamic collar reference price (hereafter "DCRP") ... For certain futures contracts, static collars shall be applicable ... Future Spike Protection (FSP) provides protection for the futures markets from extreme price movements within a short timeframe ... Future Limit Protection (FLIP) works similarly to FSP, but once triggered it will instead reserve the instrument on which the boundaries were breached.

main_board.zh: 主力合约（『Blue Month』，即成交量/持仓量最活跃的到期月，由交易所认定）：以『未来市场价格法』（future market price）确定动态参考价DCRP时，直接由该合约的中央订单簿行情算出；具体区间幅度（价差值）未见以百分比等明文形式列示于规则正文，而是逐合约通过标准数据文件（Reference Spread参考表）分发，本次未获取到该数据文件的实际数值
main_board.en: The Main Contract (the "Blue Month" — the most actively traded expiry by volume/open interest, as determined by the Exchange): when using the "future market price" method, its Dynamic Collar Reference Price (DCRP) is derived directly from that contract's own Central Order Book activity. The actual band width is not disclosed as a plain percentage in the rulebook text — it is distributed per contract via a standing-data Reference Spread file; the actual figures were not obtained this session

sources.title: Euronext Derivatives Markets - Trading Procedures（生效 2025-02-25，TP 2.1.3）
Trading safeguards on the Euronext markets（Derivatives trading safeguards / Dynamic Collar Determination 一节）

main_board.quote: In respect of the "future market price" method, a DCRP is established for the most actively traded ("blue") contract maturity and, for all other contract maturities, the DCRP is derived from outright and implied spread relationships with the blue maturity DCRP. ... Obtain the MQS and AQS Multiplier from the Reference Spread table

other_boards.zh: 其他到期月合约：动态参考价DCRP不独立计算，而是依据与主力合约（Blue Month）DCRP之间的正常/隐含价差关系（outright and implied spread relationships）推导得出；静态区间方面，Call Phase阶段的静态参考价取上一官方收盘价或最后结算价，Call Phase结束后更新为开盘揭示价或开盘时的DCRP值，其他到期月的静态参考价同样按上述『与主力合约的价差关系』方法计算
other_boards.en: Other expiry months: the Dynamic Collar Reference Price (DCRP) is not calculated independently but derived from outright and implied spread relationships with the Blue Month's DCRP. For static collars, the static reference price during the Call Phase is the last official closing price or last daily settlement price, updated after the Call Phase to the opening uncrossing price (or the DCRP value at opening); static reference prices for other maturities are likewise derived using the same spread-relationship method

sources.title: Euronext Derivatives Markets - Trading Procedures（生效 2025-02-25，TP 2.1.3, 2.1.8A）

other_boards.quote: for all other contract maturities, the DCRP is derived from outright and implied spread relationships with the blue maturity DCRP ... The static reference price for the blue maturity during the Call Phase is the last official closing price or failing this the last daily settlement price. Following the Call Phase, the static reference price is updated to become the opening uncrossing price, if any, or the DCRP value at opening. The reference prices for the other maturities are calculated as defined in Trading Procedure 2.1.3.

circuit_breaker.zh: 未见独立于价格区间机制之外的全市场/指数级熔断；个股级（此处即『逐合约级』）的动态/静态区间（见price_limits）与Future Spike/Limit Interruption Protection已构成主要保护手段，触发后进入预约（reservation）而非直接停牌，与本所现货市场（同样未发现独立的全市场级熔断）情况一致。受控词表 circuit_breaker_type 的既有选项（none/index_level/stock_level/both）均以『股票』为设计语境，与衍生品『逐合约』颗粒度不完全对应，本字段因此不代入 enum，仅作文字描述
circuit_breaker.en: No market-wide or index-level circuit breaker separate from the price-band mechanism was found; contract-level (i.e. per-instrument) dynamic/static collars (see price_limits) plus Future Spike/Limit Interruption Protection are the main safeguards, triggering a reservation rather than a flat halt — consistent with this exchange's cash market (which likewise showed no separate market-wide circuit breaker). The existing `circuit_breaker_type` enum options (none/index_level/stock_level/both) are all designed around a stock-market context and do not cleanly map onto derivatives' "per-contract" granularity, so no enum value is assigned here — text description only

circuit_breaker.quote: attempts to trade outside the prevailing dynamic collars will be blocked by the matching engine ... reservation of trading ... 'reservation' that refers to interruption on a given Instrument due to the potential matching of orders outside prevailing dynamic or static, where appropriate, collars

volatility_interruption.zh: 预约（Reservation）机制：连续交易阶段若潜在撮合价触及动态或静态区间边界即触发预约，标的合约转入一段程序化的Call Phase重新集合竞价；因动态区间触发的首次预约，恢复方式分两种——自动方式（系统按更新后的动态区间尝试重新揭示，对特定合约类别在达到最大尝试次数后可撤销引发预约的订单）或人工方式（针对静态区间触发的预约，由Market Services评估市场情况后决定是否恢复）；若自动方式重新揭示后同方向再次触发预约，是否进一步调整区间/参考价同样须转交人工评估
volatility_interruption.en: Reservation mechanism: during continuous trading, if the theoretical matching price breaches the dynamic or static collar boundary, a reservation is triggered and the instrument switches to a timed Call Phase for re-uncrossing; for the first reservation caused by a dynamic-collar breach, resumption follows one of two processes — an automated process (the system attempts to reopen using updated dynamic collars, and for certain contract categories the order causing the reservation can be cancelled after a maximum number of attempts) or a manual process (for static-collar-triggered reservations, Market Services decides whether to resume after assessing market conditions); if the automated reopening breaches again in the same direction, any further adjustment to the collars/reference price likewise requires manual assessment

sources.title: Euronext Derivatives Markets - Trading Procedures（生效 2025-02-25，TP 2.4.1-2.4.2）

volatility_interruption.quote: 'reservation' that refers to interruption on a given Instrument due to the potential matching of orders outside prevailing dynamic or static, where appropriate, collars ... When the interruption results from reservation, the Instrument impacted shall switch to a Call Phase for a programmed period of time ... For attempts to match outside dynamic collars or Future Limit Interruption Protection, automated attempts to reopen trading are conducted by the system ... For attempts to match outside static collars, a manual process is followed whereby Market Services can determine to reopen based on their assessment of market conditions.

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 除价格区间触发的『预约』（见volatility_interruption）外，另有『暂停』（suspension，因监管性质原因、标的临时中断或维持公平有序市场而触发）与『技术性停牌』（halt，因技术故障触发）两类独立于价格机制的干预手段；若中断发生在每日结算价/官方收盘价确定前后，交易所可自行决定改期确定时点或以其认定的公允价格直接设定结算价；若中断预计无法在收盘前或收盘前足够时间内恢复，交易所可推迟收盘时点，或决定顺延至下一交易日甚至更晚的交易日恢复交易，相关决定可撤销并可另行公告替代性交易安排
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Beyond the price-band-triggered "reservation" (see volatility_interruption), two further intervention types exist independent of the price mechanism: "suspension" (triggered by regulatory reasons, a temporary interruption in the underlying, or to maintain a fair and orderly market) and "halt" (triggered by a technical failure). If an interruption occurs around the time the Daily Settlement Price/official closing price is due to be set, the Exchange may either change the timing for that Trading Day or set the price at a level it determines to be a fair reflection of the market. If an interruption cannot be resolved before, or with sufficient time before, Market Close, the Exchange may delay the closing time, or resume trading on a later Trading Day (or an even later one); such determinations may be revoked and alternative trading arrangements published separately

sources.title: Euronext Derivatives Markets - Trading Procedures（生效 2025-02-25，TP 2.4.1, 2.4.3-2.4.7）

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: 'suspension' that refers to interruption of regulatory nature, or due to temporary interruption of the underlying, or to maintain a fair and orderly market; 'halt' that refers to interruption of technical nature ... the Relevant Euronext Market Undertaking may in its absolute discretion determine either: (a) to change such times for that Trading Day; or (b) to set such prices at levels determined by them as being a fair reflection of the market ... it may determine that the conduct of business in one or more Exchange Contracts should be resumed but that the relevant scheduled closing time should be delayed to a later time.

block_trade.zh: 股票/股指/固定收益迷你期货等适用『大宗交易设施』（Large-in-Scale Trade Facility, LiS）：交易时段通常早于/长于中央订单簿正常时段（如CAC 40期货LiS为07:30-22:00，早于COB的08:00-22:00），最小交易量门槛逐合约公布于官网，策略交易（含跨合约价差）每条腿原则上须独立达标（流动性差的组合策略可仅一条腿达标，判定标准援引MiFIR相关条款）；交易须由执行会员以其认定的『公允价值』申报价格，经交易所核准后方可完成；商品衍生品另设独立命名的『Block Trade Facility』（含Block Standard/Block NFC Auction/Block Historical等子类型），规则细节与LiS不完全相同，本次未逐条核实；此外还有EFS/EOO（合约与场外掉期/期权互换）、Against Actuals（合约与实货互换）等专门的场外/技术性交易设施
block_trade.en: Equity/index/fixed-income mini-futures etc. are eligible for the Large-in-Scale Trade Facility (LiS): its trading window is generally earlier/longer than the normal Central Order Book session (e.g. CAC 40 futures LiS runs 07:30-22:00 vs COB's 08:00-22:00); minimum volume thresholds are published per contract on the Exchange website; for strategy trades (including inter-contract spreads), in principle each leg must independently meet the threshold (illiquid strategies, per MiFIR criteria, need only one leg to qualify). Trades must be reported by the Executing Member at a price the Member considers "Fair Value" and require Exchange authorisation to complete. Commodity derivatives instead use a separately-named "Block Trade Facility" (with sub-types including Block Standard/Block NFC Auction/Block Historical), whose detailed rules were not individually verified this session and are not identical to LiS. Dedicated off-book/technical facilities also exist: EFS/EOO (Exchange for Swaps / Exchange of Options for Options) and Against Actuals (exchange against physical)

market_maker_scheme.zh: 做市商角色分三类：MMA（Market Maker Agreement，标准做市协议）、MMS（Market Maker Scheme，做市商计划）、MME（Market Maker for Extended Hours，仅适用于部分股指期货的晚间交易时段）；同一会员（按Firm ID）在同一合约同一（日间）场次只能担任MMA或MMS其中之一，但可在不同合约分别担任不同角色；做市商须在每个交易场次开始前于Optiq逐合约『签到』（MM Sign-In），未获授权的合约签到会被单独拒绝；做市商在其报价的各合约订单簿中须维持买卖双边报价以满足流动性提供义务，并可配置做市商保护（Market Maker Protection, MMP）机制以在被连续扫单成交时获得一定保护
market_maker_scheme.en: Three Market Maker (MM) role types exist: MMA (Market Maker Agreement, the standard MM agreement), MMS (Market Maker Scheme), and MME (Market Maker for Extended Hours, available only for the evening trading session on certain index futures). The same member (by Firm ID) can hold only one of MMA or MMS on a given contract during the same (daytime) session, but may hold different roles on different contracts. MMs must "sign in" per contract on Optiq before each trading session (MM Sign-In); sign-in attempts on unauthorised contracts are individually rejected. MMs must maintain two-sided (bid/offer) quotes in each order book they quote, to fulfil their liquidity-provision obligations, and can configure Market Maker Protection (MMP) for a degree of protection against being repeatedly "swept"

market_maker_scheme.quote: Market Makers (MMs) are required to maintain bid and offer prices in all individual order books of the contract for which they are obliged to provide liquidity ... Examples of MM roles in the Euronext Derivatives Markets are i) Market Maker Agreement (MMA), ii) Market Maker Scheme (MMS) and iii) Market Maker for Extended Hours (MME, on some index futures only). A Euronext derivatives member (identified by a Member Firm ID) can either be MMA or MMS, on a given contract, during the daily session ... MMs sign in before their trading session on Optiq®... Any sign-in attempt on a contract on which the Firm does not have Market making authorisation will be individually rejected. ... Market Maker Protection (MMP): facility that offers registered Market Makers (MM) and Liquidity Providers (LP) a degree of protection against being traded out

margin_practice_note.zh: 结算所层面：2024年9月，Euronext Clearing完成对全部Euronext衍生品市场的清算接管，取代此前的中央对手方LCH S.A.，是集团多资产统一清算整合（收购Borsa Italiana集团三年后）的最后一步；按资产类别采用不同保证金方法论——权益及权益衍生品、意大利/西班牙/爱尔兰/葡萄牙政府债（FIRE）、农产品衍生品采用『类VaR』动态保证金方法论（基于现金流映射的历史模拟预期尾部损失Expected Shortfall，并辅以EWMA波动率缩放及针对特异性/流动性/集中度/结算/回购风险的附加保证金）；公司债及FIRE覆盖以外的政府债仍沿用『类SPAN』保证金方法论（MVP）；权益及权益衍生品的VaR方法论于2023年10月上线替代此前的SPAN类方法（MARS）
margin_practice_note.en: At the CCP level: in September 2024, Euronext Clearing completed the takeover of clearing for all Euronext derivatives markets, replacing the previous CCP LCH S.A. — the final step of the group's multi-asset clearing consolidation (three years after acquiring the Borsa Italiana Group). Margin methodology differs by asset class: equities & equity derivatives, Italian/Spanish/Irish/Portuguese government bonds (FIRE), and agricultural commodity derivatives use a dynamic (auto-updating) "VaR-like" methodology (a historical-simulation Expected Shortfall based on cash-flow mapping, with EWMA volatility scaling and add-ons for idiosyncratic/liquidity/concentration/settlement/repo risks); corporate bonds and government bonds outside the FIRE scope still use a "SPAN-like" methodology (MVP). The VaR-like methodology for equities & equity derivatives went live in October 2023, replacing the prior SPAN-like methodology (MARS)

margin_practice_note.quote: Margins are a fundamental risk management tool adopted by Euronext Clearing. Each Clearing Member must post margins to cover the theoretical costs which Euronext Clearing would incur in the event of the CM's default and the clearing of its open position. ... Margins are calculated using efficient, reliable and accurate systems: VaR-like margin methodologies for Italian, Spanish, Irish and Portuguese government bonds (FIRE), equities and equity derivatives, agricultural commodity derivatives; SPAN-like margin methodology for corporate bonds and government bonds other than the abovementioned (MVP) ... In October 2023 Euronext Clearing replaced its longstanding SPAN-like margin methodology with a new dynamic (i.e. auto-updating) VaR-like margin methodology ... Euronext, the leading pan-European market infrastructure, is pleased to announce the successful completion of the expansion of Euronext Clearing activities to all Euronext financial derivatives markets. This milestone marks the conclusion of the migration from LCH SA to Euronext Clearing

continuing_obligations.zh: 上市后发行人须持续履行欧盟法/本国法规定的披露义务：及时发布定期财务信息（年报与半年报，适用时经审计），且任何可能影响证券定价的重大信息须平等、及时地提供给所有证券持有人，使其得以行使权利。此外，发行人对拟进行的重大公司行为须提前通知相关市场运营实体。
continuing_obligations.en: Post-admission, an issuer must continuously meet its disclosure obligations under Union/National law: it shall publish periodic financial information (annual and half-yearly reports, audited where applicable) in a timely manner, and shall make any material information that may affect the pricing of its securities available to all holders equally and in a timely manner so they can exercise their rights. In addition, for any planned material corporate action the issuer must give advance notice to the relevant Market Undertaking.

continuing_obligations.quote: An Issuer shall provide the market all necessary information to enable holders of its Securities to exercise their rights. suspension_resumption.zh: 市场运营实体可主动（依其自主裁量）或在发行人有理由请求下，为防范或制止无序市场状况而暂停任一证券的交易；此外，应主管机关（Competent Authority）请求亦必须暂停。恢复交易采用集合竞价（auction）方式，在预定的下一轮集合竞价时点重新撮合恢复，而非连续竞价即时恢复。
suspension_resumption.en: The relevant Market Undertaking may, on its own initiative (in its sole discretion) or at the reasoned request of the relevant issuer, suspend trading in any security in order to prevent or halt disorderly market conditions; it must also suspend trading upon the request of a Competent Authority. Resumption is effected through an auction: trading resumes at the next scheduled auction, rather than being restored instantaneously in continuous trading.

suspension_resumption.quote: The Relevant Euronext Market Undertaking may suspend trading in any Security in order to prevent or halt disorderly market conditions, either on its own initiative, and in its sole discretion, or at the reasoned request of the relevant Issuer. In addition, the Relevant Euronext Market Undertaking shall suspend trading in any Security upon the request of a Competent Authority. ... the trading resumption process shall consist of a postponement to the next auction planned.

delisting_process.zh: 证券的移除（delisting/removal）可由三类情形触发：应相关发行人申请；应主管机关（Competent Authority）依本国法规提出的请求；或市场运营实体作为市场运营者/上市主管机关依职权主动移除。此外，市场运营实体还可基于多种适当理由主动移除证券，包括发行人明显未履行规则或申请表项下义务、发行人法人主体清算/合并/解散、发行人破产、或认为无法维持该证券的公允有序市场等。
delisting_process.en: Removal of securities (delisting/removal) may be triggered by three grounds: at the request of the relevant issuer; at the request of the competent authority pursuant to National Regulations; or on the Market Undertaking's own initiative as market operator or as the competent authority in terms of listing. In addition, the Market Undertaking may remove securities on its own initiative on any appropriate grounds, including the issuer's manifest failure to comply with the Rules or Application Form, liquidation/merger/dissolution of the issuing entity, bankruptcy of the issuer, or the opinion that a fair, orderly and efficient market cannot be maintained.

sources.title: Euronext Rule Book Book I - Harmonised Rules（Rule 6905/1 移除）

delisting_process.quote: Subject to National Regulations, each Relevant Euronext Market Undertaking may remove Securities admitted to listing and/or trading on its markets: (i) at the request of the relevant Issuer; or (ii) on its own initiative as market operator or as competent authority in terms of listing, as the case maybe; or (iii) at the request of the competent authority pursuant to National Regulations.

delisting_transition_period.zh: 统一的《Harmonised Rulebook》对证券的移除（delisting/removal）未规定统一的过渡期或最短提前通知窗口——规则仅列明移除的触发情形，未像部分成员国市场规则那样设定「移除前须提前若干交易日公告」的统一期限。各市场运营实体可能在各自的 Book II 细则中追加通知要求，本次未逐市场核实。
delisting_transition_period.en: The harmonised rulebook does not prescribe a uniform transition period or minimum advance-notice window for the removal of securities (delisting/removal) — it sets out only the triggering grounds, without a group-wide "must give X trading days' notice before removal" deadline. Individual Market Undertakings may add notice requirements in their own Book II rules; these were not verified market-by-market this session.
delisting_transition_period.detail: 属「规则统一但法人与监管分立」结构下的真实留白：统一规则手册不辖此细节；未断言不存在，仅说明在 harmonised 层面无统一规定，故不填具体天数，标 medium。

sources.title: Euronext Rule Book Book I - Harmonised Rules（Rule 6905/1 移除）

post_delisting_venue.zh: 统一规则手册未规定退市后证券必须迁移至某一特定场所；实践中，拟从 Euronext 受监管市场摘牌、但希望继续在具有类似特征的市场挂牌的发行人，须遵循「销售便利程序」(sales facility procedure)——例如 AdUX 从 Euronext 受监管市场退市后转入 Euronext Growth Paris 继续交易。各市场运营实体（如 Euronext Access Paris 规则手册）对「转至另一多边交易设施/受监管市场/第三国市场」设有明确的销售便利程序。
post_delisting_venue.en: The harmonised rulebook does not mandate migration to any specific venue after delisting; in practice, an issuer wishing to leave the Euronext regulated market but continue trading on a market with equivalent characteristics must follow a "sales facility procedure" — for example, AdUX moved from the Euronext regulated market to Euronext Growth Paris to keep trading. Each Market Undertaking's rulebook (e.g. the Euronext Access Paris rulebook) sets out an explicit sales-facility procedure for transfers to another MTF, regulated market or third-country market.

delivery_method.zh: 现货市场为主，不适用衍生品式交割概念；集团旗下另有衍生品市场（见products章节）存在实物/现金交割安排，但本文件聚焦现货Securities Markets，衍生品市场交割方式本次未逐一核实
delivery_method.en: Predominantly a cash-equity market — the physical/cash delivery concept does not apply; the Group's derivatives markets (see products chapter) do carry physical/cash delivery arrangements, but this file focuses on the Securities (cash) Markets and derivatives-market delivery terms were not individually verified this session

sources.title: Choosing a Market（Euronext官网，用于确认Euronext/Euronext Growth/Euronext Access三板块均为股票现货市场性质）

default_management.zh: Euronext Clearing 采用多层风险防护：每日向清算会员（Clearing Member）收取保证金以覆盖其违约及平仓的 theoretical 成本；此外设立「违约基金」(Default Fund) 作为额外、互助式的保护层，覆盖超出保证金的极端但合理的风险。违约处置按 EMIR 框架下的损失分担层级（保证金→违约基金→CCP 自有资本）进行，但具体逐层参数本次未逐条核实。
default_management.en: Euronext Clearing applies a multi-layered risk framework: margins are called on a daily basis to cover the theoretical costs it would incur in the event of a Clearing Member's default and the clearing of its open positions; in addition, a Default Fund provides an additional, mutualistic layer of protection aimed at covering extreme but plausible risks not captured by margins. Default handling follows the EMIR loss-waterfall hierarchy (margins → Default Fund → CCP own capital), but the exact per-tranche parameters were not individually verified this session.

sources.title: Euronext Clearing Risk Management（官网）

default_management.quote: Margins are called on a daily basis to cover the theoretical costs which Euronext Clearing would incur in the event of the CM's default and the clearing of its open positions. Default Funds are an additional, mutualistic layer of protection aimed at protecting the CCP from extreme but plausible risks, not captured by margins.

initial_margin_practice.zh: Euronext Clearing 按资产类别采用不同保证金方法论：权益及权益衍生品、意大利/西班牙/爱尔兰/葡萄牙政府债（FIRE）、农产品衍生品采用动态（自动更新）的「类 VaR」方法论（基于现金流映射的历史模拟预期尾部损失 Expected Shortfall，辅以 EWMA 波动率缩放及特异性/流动性/集中度/结算/回购风险附加保证金）；公司债及 FIRE 覆盖以外的政府债沿用「类 SPAN」方法论（MVP）。权益及权益衍生品的 VaR 方法论已上线，取代原 SPAN 类方法（MARS）。
initial_margin_practice.en: Euronext Clearing applies different margin methodologies by asset class: equities & equity derivatives, Italian/Spanish/Irish/Portuguese government bonds (FIRE) and agricultural commodity derivatives use a dynamic (auto-updating) "VaR-like" methodology (a historical-simulation Expected Shortfall based on cash-flow mapping, with EWMA volatility scaling and add-ons for idiosyncratic/liquidity/concentration/settlement/repo risks); corporate bonds and government bonds outside FIRE still use a "SPAN-like" methodology (MVP). The VaR-like methodology for equities & equity derivatives has gone live, replacing the prior SPAN-like methodology (MARS).

sources.title: Euronext Clearing Risk Management（官网）

initial_margin_practice.quote: Margins are calculated using efficient, reliable and accurate systems: VaR-like margin methodologies for Italian, Spanish, Irish and Portuguese government bonds (FIRE), equities and equity derivatives, agricultural commodity derivatives; SPAN-like margin methodology for corporate bonds and government bonds other than the abovementioned (MVP)

maintenance_margin_practice.zh: Euronext Clearing 逐日收取变动保证金（variation margin），覆盖清算会员持仓随市价变动的每日损益，使其保证金账户始终反映当前风险敞口；即「每日盯市、逐日追保」的维持机制，与初始保证金（覆盖极端但合理风险）共同构成双层防护。
maintenance_margin_practice.en: Euronext Clearing collects variation margin on a daily basis to cover the daily profit/loss of a Clearing Member's open positions, keeping the margin account continuously reflective of current risk exposure — a "daily mark-to-market, daily top-up" maintenance mechanism that, together with initial margin (covering extreme but plausible risk), forms the two-layer protection.

sources.title: Euronext Clearing Risk Management（官网）

maintenance_margin_practice.quote: Margins are called on a daily basis to cover the theoretical costs which Euronext Clearing would incur in the event of the CM's default and the clearing of its open positions.

mark_to_market_frequency.zh: 衍生品合约每日进行盯市：期货合约的每日结算价（Daily Settlement Price, DSP）按「中央订单簿价格法」或「官方收盘价法」二者之一计算（具体某合约采用哪种方法见 Annexe One）；结算价用于逐日计提变动保证金。
mark_to_market_frequency.en: Derivatives contracts are marked to market daily: for futures, the Daily Settlement Price (DSP) is calculated using either the Central Order Book price method or the official closing price method (which method applies to which contract is set out in Annexe One); the settlement price is used to compute variation margin on a daily basis.

sources.title: Euronext Derivatives Markets - Trading Procedures（生效 2025-02-25，TP 2.2）

mark_to_market_frequency.quote: The Daily Settlement Price for Futures Contracts is calculated using one of the following two methods: (a) Central Order Book price method ...; or (b) official closing price method

delivery_method.zh: Euronext 衍生品多为现金结算；其市场运作文件说明，对电力等衍生品，交易所在到期日（Expiration Date）依据相关合约标的在交割期内发布的适用现货价格均值确定 EDSP（到期结算价）。
delivery_method.en: Euronext derivatives are predominantly cash-settled; the market-operations document states that for (e.g. Power) derivatives the exchange determines an EDSP on the Expiration Date using the average of the applicable Spot Prices published in the Delivery period by the issuer of the relevant Contract Underlying.

sources.title: Euronext Derivatives – How the Market Works（v5.4, 2025, § contract specs）

delivery_method.quote: For monthly, weekly and daily Power Derivatives the exchange determines an EDSP on the Expiration Date by using the average of the applicable Spot Prices published in the Delivery period by the issuer (Nord Pool) of the relevant Contract Underlying

last_trading_day_rule.zh: 衍生品合约在最后交易日（Last Trading Day）收盘时，所有未成交订单（含 GTC 与 GTD 订单）将被取消；最后交易日的具体日期逐合约列于 Annexe One，股票/股指类通常早于标的现货到期。
last_trading_day_rule.en: On the Last Trading Day of a derivatives contract, all resting orders — including GTC and GTD orders — are cancelled at the close of business; the exact Last Trading Day date is set out per contract in Annexe One, and for equity/index products it typically falls earlier than the underlying cash expiry.

sources.title: Euronext Derivatives Markets - Trading Procedures（生效 2025-02-25，TP 3.2.9）

last_trading_day_rule.quote: All orders, including GTC and GTD orders, will be cancelled at close of business on the Last Trading Day of the delivery month to which they relate

investor_structure.zh: 投资者结构以机构为主，零售参与度近年受欧盟 Retail Investment Strategy 推动受到更多关注；Euronext 定期发布投资者结构统计（零售 vs 机构），但具体各市场细分比例本次未逐一核实。
investor_structure.en: The investor base is predominantly institutional, with retail participation receiving increased attention in recent years under the EU Retail Investment Strategy; Euronext publishes periodic investor-structure statistics (retail vs institutional), but the exact per-market breakdown was not individually verified this session.
investor_structure.detail: 属市场结构层面的定性判断，非交易所自设规则；具体零售/机构占比数字未逐一核实，confidence 标 medium。

account_opening_requirements.zh: 个人投资者无法直接在 Euronext 交易平台上开户交易，必须通过银行、经纪商或私人财富管理公司（broker / bank / private wealth manager）作为中介下单；开户的具体身份与资金要求由各中介依其本国 KYC/反洗钱规则执行，交易所层面不向终端投资者直接开户。
account_opening_requirements.en: Private investors cannot trade directly with the Exchange; they require a bank, broker or private wealth manager to execute their order on the Euronext trading platform. The specific identity and funding requirements for opening an account are set by each intermediary under its home-country KYC / anti-money-laundering rules; the exchange does not open accounts directly for end investors.

sources.title: Euronext Amsterdam — Markets（官网，投资者参与方式）

account_opening_requirements.quote: Private investors cannot trade directly with the Exchange. You require a bank, broker or private wealth manager to execute your order on the Euronext trading platform. Our broker list provides you with an overview of accredited intermediaries.

suitability_management.zh: 投资者适当性（suitability / appropriateness）管理由会员（经纪商/银行）依欧盟 MiFID II 对客户分类与产品适当性要求执行，交易所层面不直接对终端投资者做适当性评估；Euronext 作为市场运营者通过会员纪律与市场监控间接保障市场秩序。
suitability_management.en: Suitability / appropriateness management is performed by members (brokers / banks) under EU MiFID II client-classification and product-governance requirements; the exchange does not assess suitability for end investors directly, and indirectly safeguards market order through member discipline and market surveillance.
suitability_management.detail: 属会员合规职责，非交易所自设规则；未附强 quote，confidence 标 medium。

sources.title: Regulatory Framework（Euronext 官网，逐国监管机构列表）

foreign_access_channel.zh: 境外投资者参与 Euronext 有两条路径：(1) 成为 Euronext 会员（需获本国监管授权，EEA 内依 MiFID II 护照便利，第三国 firm 亦可在满足条件下申请）；(2) 通过已入会的本地经纪商/银行下单。集团统一的「Euronext Membership」体系使一家会员可交易横跨七个市场的现货与衍生品，降低了跨境接入门槛。
foreign_access_channel.en: Foreign investors can access Euronext through two routes: (1) becoming a Euronext Member (requires home-regulator authorisation; within the EEA this is eased by the MiFID II passport, and third-country firms may also apply subject to conditions); or (2) routing orders through an already-admitted local broker / bank. The group's unified "Euronext Membership" regime lets one member trade across all seven markets' cash and derivatives, lowering the cross-border access barrier.
foreign_access_channel.detail: 属会员资格/监管框架事实，非交易所自设规则；具体某国投资者最便捷通道取决于其本国中介是否在会员之列，confidence 标 medium。

sources.title: Euronext Membership — Admission process（官网）

membership_structure.zh: 统一的「Euronext Membership」资格体系：申请人须向拟加入的具体市场运营实体（Relevant Euronext Market Undertaking）申请并获书面批准，资质要求含本国监管机构授权/牌照、员工须具备英语或所在法域语言的业务能力、充足的组织与资源安排等；会籍不可转让；自然人与独资企业不得成为Euronext证券市场会员
membership_structure.en: A unified "Euronext Membership" regime: an applicant must apply to, and receive the written approval of, the specific Market Undertaking it wishes to join, subject to eligibility criteria including home-regulator authorisation, staff fluency in English or the relevant jurisdiction's language, and adequate organisational/resource arrangements; membership is non-transferable; natural persons and sole proprietorships are not eligible to become Euronext Securities Members

sources.title: Euronext Rule Book Book I - Harmonised Rules（Chapter 2 Euronext Membership）

membership_structure.quote: Natural persons and sole proprietorships are not eligible to become Euronext Securities Members.

broker_landscape.zh: Euronext 采用统一的「Euronext Membership」会员体系，当前获授权在现货及/或衍生品市场交易的交易会员共 293 家（截至 2026 年官网更新）；会员含银行、经纪商、自营交易公司等，分布横跨七个市场所属国及部分第三国。终端投资者须通过这些会员（见 account_opening_requirements）间接参与。
broker_landscape.en: Euronext operates a unified "Euronext Membership" regime; currently 293 trading members are authorised to trade on the cash and/or derivatives markets (as of the 2026 website update). Members include banks, brokers and proprietary trading firms, spanning the seven Market Undertakings' home countries and a number of third countries. End investors must access the market indirectly through these members (see account_opening_requirements).

market_data_levels.zh: Euronext 市场数据按深度分四档：Level 3（完整订单簿深度，逐笔更新/修改/取消）、Level 2（聚合深度的买一卖一及笔数）、Level 1（最佳买卖价及量，含 Last Price）、Last Price（成交价量、开高低收）。各档按月收费，费率因资产类别（如 CASH / Euronext Funds）而异。
market_data_levels.en: Euronext market data is offered at four depth levels: Level 3 (the full depth of the order book with updates for each new order, modification or cancellation), Level 2 (the full depth of the order book with aggregated volumes and associated number of orders), Level 1 (the best bid and offer per instrument, i.e. prices and quantities, including Last Price), and Last Price (the traded prices and quantities, open, high, low and closing prices). Each level is charged monthly, with fees varying by asset class (e.g. CASH / Euronext Funds).

sources.title: Euronext Information Product Fee Schedule（V21.1，effective 1 October 2026）

market_data_levels.quote: Level 3 ■ The full depth of the order book with updates for each new order, modification or cancellation ... Level 2 ■ The full depth of the order book with aggregated volumes and associated number of orders ... Level 1 ■ The best bid and offer per financial instrument, i.e., prices and quantities ... Last Price ■ The traded prices and quantities, open, high, low and closing prices

data_latency.zh: Euronext 交易平台 Optiq 的平均性能延迟低至 15 微秒（order roundtrip 及市场数据均适用），是高频低延迟交易的技术基础。
data_latency.en: Euronext's Optiq trading platform demonstrates an average performance latency as low as 15 micro-seconds for order roundtrip as well as for market data, providing the technical basis for high-frequency, low-latency trading.

sources.title: Euronext launches Optiq®（新闻稿，2018-07-10）

data_latency.quote: Optiq® has demonstrated an average performance latency of as low as 15 micro-seconds for order roundtrip as well as for market data

data_pricing_model.zh: Euronext 市场数据采用分级定价：实时数据通常按用户类别（如专业/非专业、分发范围）收费；延迟数据（delayed）若仅用于内部用途则免费。具体各档费率见信息产品费率表（按 Euro 计、按月收取）。
data_pricing_model.en: Euronext market data uses tiered pricing: real-time data is generally charged by user category (e.g. professional/non-professional, distribution scope); delayed market data is free of charge if used for internal purposes only. Exact per-level fees are set out in the Information Product Fee Schedule (stated in Euro, per month).

sources.title: Euronext Market Data Pricing Policies（官网）

data_pricing_model.quote: Please note, the use of delayed market data is free of charge if it is used for internal purposes only.

historical_data_availability.zh: Euronext 通过 NextHistory 提供历史市场数据，产品含：End of Day Summary (EOD)（每日市场摘要，含开高低收、成交量与成交额）；Trade Data（中央订单簿与 TCS 场外申报成交，并含 EOD）；Best Bid and Offer (BBO)（最佳买卖价及盘口快照，第一层，附 Trade 与 EOD 摘要）；Full Order Book（全部 Euronext 市场现货与衍生品的完整订单簿，含 new/modify/fill/cancel/reload 全事件类型）。
historical_data_availability.en: Euronext provides historical market data via NextHistory, with products including: End of Day Summary (EOD) (daily market summaries featuring open, high, low, and last prices, volumes, and turnover); Trade Data (central order book and TCS reported off-market trades, along with the EOD); Best Bid and Offer (BBO) (the best bid and offer with a book snapshot at the first level, supplemented by Trade and EOD Summary Data); and Full Order Book (a complete view of the order book for all Euronext cash and derivatives markets, covering all event types such as new, modify, fill, cancel and reload).

trading_system_name.detail: 2017年上线的自有交易平台，覆盖集团全部现货与衍生品市场（含2023-2024年分阶段完成的Borsa Italiana迁移），是七个市场共享统一中央订单簿的技术基础

access_methods.zh: 接入市场数据有两种主要方式：其一，通过 Optiq MDG 直连，获取低延迟实时数据（批量推送，Euronext 不做前置过滤）；其二，经由数据商（data vendors）间接获取——超过 40 家数据商分发 Euronext 实时市场数据。交易接入则通过会员（Euronext Membership）经 Optiq 协议连接。
access_methods.en: There are two main ways to access market data: first, direct access through Optiq® MDG, which provides low-latency real-time market data (bulk information, with Euronext not filtering any data before dispatch); and second, indirect access via data vendors — more than 40 data vendors distribute Euronext real-time market data. Trading access is via Euronext Membership over the Optiq protocol.

access_methods.quote: Direct access through Optiq® MDG provides clients access to low latency real-time market data, with maximum flexibility, simplified and harmonized messaging as well as high performance and stability. ... More than 40 data vendors distribute Euronext real-time market data.

major_outage_history.zh: 2020 年 10 月 19 日，Euronext 因一个数据管理系统发生故障，导致阿姆斯特丹/布鲁塞尔/里斯本/巴黎/都柏林的现货市场停牌逾三小时（奥斯陆未受影响）；为近年最严重的一次全市场级技术中断。此后 Euronext 强化了监控与灾备能力。
major_outage_history.en: On 19 October 2020, a failure in one of Euronext's data management systems halted trading for more than three hours across the Amsterdam, Brussels, Lisbon, Paris and Dublin cash markets (Oslo was unaffected) — the most severe market-wide technical outage in recent years. Euronext has since strengthened its monitoring and business-continuity capabilities.

major_outage_history.quote: Trading in those locations came to standstill for more than three hours on Monday morning due to a technical failure impacting one of its data management systems.

commission_structure.zh: 投资者向经纪商支付的佣金由各家经纪商自定，非交易所统一规则；Euronext 仅向会员收取交易费（见 exchange_fees），不向终端投资者直接收费，故无统一佣金表。结构通常为按笔/按金额的比例佣金或固定费用，因经纪商与账户类型而异。
commission_structure.en: The commission an investor pays to a broker is set by each broker individually, not by a unified exchange rule; Euronext only charges trading fees to its members (see exchange_fees) and does not charge end investors directly, so there is no single commission schedule. The structure is typically a per-trade or ad-valorem percentage commission or a fixed fee, varying by broker and account type.
commission_structure.detail: 属经纪商商业条款，非交易所规则；未附强 quote，confidence 标 medium。

exchange_fees.zh: 标准股票交易费提供两种计价方式（会员逐月二选一）：方式一（默认）按已执行订单笔数阶梯收费（前70万笔€0.13/笔，其后每笔递减至最低€0.05）+ 按月成交金额阶梯收费（从0.95个基点递减至0.45个基点）；方式二为「最低承诺费+更低单笔/按值费率」的替代方案，区分蓝筹股（CAC 40/AEX/BEL 20/PSI/SBF 120/AMX/ISEQ 20/OBX/FTSE MIB成分股）与其他证券两档费率

clearing_fees.zh: 清算费由 Euronext Clearing（CCP，法定实体 Cassa di Compensazione e Garanzia S.p.A.）按其自有清算费率表另行收取，不在本次核实的现货交易费指南（Cash Markets Trading Fee Guide）范围内；具体逐产品清算费率本次未逐一核实。
clearing_fees.en: Clearing fees are charged separately by Euronext Clearing (the CCP, legal entity Cassa di Compensazione e Garanzia S.p.A.) under its own clearing fee schedule, outside the scope of the cash-market trading fee guide verified this session; the exact per-product clearing fees were not individually verified this session.
clearing_fees.detail: 属清算所独立费率，非交易所交易费；未附强 quote，confidence 标 medium。

regulatory_fees.zh: Euronext 作为交易所/市场运营者，不直接代征「监管费」(regulatory fee) 性质的统一收费；其向会员收取的费用为交易费、做市商费、连接费等（见 exchange_fees 及现金市场费率指南），监管性收费（如各国金融监管机构对发行人/中介的规费）由各本国主管机关另行计征，不通过交易所统一代收。
regulatory_fees.en: As an exchange / market operator, Euronext does not levy a unified "regulatory fee" on behalf of any authority; the fees it charges members are trading fees, market-maker fees, connectivity fees, etc. (see exchange_fees and the cash-market fee guide). Regulatory levies (e.g. fees charged by each national financial regulator to issuers/intermediaries) are collected separately by the relevant home authority, not consolidated through the exchange.
regulatory_fees.detail: 属交易所 vs 监管机构的职责边界说明；现金市场费率指南列出的均为交易所自身费用项目，未见统一的监管费代收项，confidence 标 medium。

sources.title: Euronext Cash Markets Trading Fee Guide（生效 2026-09-01，费用项目清单）

stamp_duty.zh: 印花税属各国税法事项而非交易所规则；本所七个市场所属国中，法国自 2008 年起已废除股票交易印花税（但仍对部分衍生品/高频交易征收金融交易税，见 financial_transaction_tax），其余国家亦无针对普通股现货交易的经典「印花税」(stamp duty)。比利时/荷兰/爱尔兰/葡萄牙/挪威各有其他交易相关税种，但均非印花税性质。
stamp_duty.en: Stamp duty is a matter of each country's tax law rather than an exchange rule; among the seven markets' home countries, France abolished its stock-transaction stamp duty in 2008 (though it still levies a financial transaction tax on some derivatives / high-frequency trades, see financial_transaction_tax), and the other countries likewise have no classic "stamp duty" on ordinary cash-equity trading. Belgium, the Netherlands, Ireland, Portugal and Norway each have other transaction-related taxes, but none are stamp-duty in nature.
stamp_duty.detail: 属成员国税法，非交易所规则；法国废除股票印花税为公开常识性事实，confidence 标 medium。

sources.title: Euronext Markets — Paris（官网）

financial_transaction_tax.zh: 法国、意大利对本国上市大市值公司股票交易开征金融交易税。法国 FTT 适用于在受监管市场（法国或外国）交易的、由法国注册实体发行的、市值超过 €1 billion 的股票收购；意大利则另有类 Tobin Tax 式的股票交易税。荷兰/比利时/爱尔兰/葡萄牙/挪威税制各异，部分无此税。这是「一所多国」结构下税费类字段的典型难点——单一字段无法承接七国不同税制。
financial_transaction_tax.en: France and Italy levy financial transaction taxes on trades in large-cap domestic listed equities. The French FTT applies to acquisitions of shares traded on a regulated market (French or foreign), issued by French-incorporated entities with a market capitalisation of more than €1 billion. Italy has a separate Tobin-Tax-style equity transaction tax. The Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Portugal and Norway have varied regimes, some without such a tax. This is a typical difficulty of tax-type fields under the 'one exchange, many countries' structure — a single field cannot capture seven different tax regimes.

sources.title: Euronext — French Financial Transaction Tax Issuer CSD（服务说明文档，2025-06-23）

financial_transaction_tax.quote: The French FTT is applicable to the acquisitions (which may also result from corporate actions) of shares traded on a regulated market, French or foreign, issued by French entities (headquartered in France) with a market capitalisation of more than €1 billion on 1 December of the previous year.

capital_gains_tax.zh: 七国资本利得税制各异（如法国对居民实行 30% 一揽子税率 PFU，其他国家各有规则），且与投资者居民身份、双边税收协定相关，单一字段无法承接。本字段留作结构性 N/A，具体国别税率见各国税法。
capital_gains_tax.en: Capital-gains tax regimes differ across the seven countries (e.g. France applies a 30% flat "PFU" rate for residents, while others have their own rules) and depend on the investor's tax residency and bilateral tax treaties, so a single field cannot capture them. This field is left as a structural N/A; country-specific rates are set by each jurisdiction's tax law.
capital_gains_tax.detail: 属成员国税法，非交易所规则；法国 PFU 30% 为公开常识性事实，confidence 标 medium。

sources.title: Euronext Markets — Paris（官网）

dividend_withholding_tax.zh: 股息预扣税率因发行人所属国与投资者居民身份而异；以 Euronext 净回报指数采用的各市场所属国标准预扣税率为：法国 25.00%、比利时 30.00%、荷兰 15.00%、葡萄牙 25.00%、爱尔兰 25.00%、意大利 26.00%、挪威 25.00%（自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起适用）。实际到手税率还受双边税收协定与退税程序影响。
dividend_withholding_tax.en: Dividend withholding tax rates vary by the issuer's home country and the investor's tax residency; the standard rates used by Euronext's net-return indices for each market's home country are: France 25.00%, Belgium 30.00%, Netherlands 15.00%, Portugal 25.00%, Ireland 25.00%, Italy 26.00%, Norway 25.00% (applied from 1 January 2026). The effective rate is also affected by bilateral tax treaties and refund procedures.

implicit_costs_note.zh: 除显性费用外，投资者还承担买卖价差（bid-ask spread）、市场冲击等隐性成本；Euronext 官网定位自身为「欧洲最大的流动性池」(largest liquidity pool in Europe)，整体流动性较好，主要指数成分股价差较窄，但 Euronext Access/Growth 等小市值板块及部分流动性较弱的证券隐性成本显著更高。
implicit_costs_note.en: Beyond explicit fees, investors bear implicit costs such as the bid-ask spread and market impact; Euronext describes itself as "the largest liquidity pool in Europe", so overall liquidity is good and spreads on major index constituents are tight, but on smaller-cap segments such as Euronext Access/Growth and on less-liquid names the implicit cost is materially higher.

fx_risk_note.zh: 六个欧元区市场（阿姆斯特丹/布鲁塞尔/都柏林/里斯本/巴黎/米兰）无资本管制，欧元自由浮动；奥斯陆市场以非欧元的挪威克朗（NOK）计价结算，是本所内部唯一存在真实汇率敞口的市场，交易该市场证券对欧元区投资者构成汇率风险，其余六个市场之间无汇率风险
fx_risk_note.en: The six euro-area markets (Amsterdam, Brussels, Dublin, Lisbon, Paris, Milan) have no capital controls and the euro floats freely; the Oslo market is priced and settled in Norwegian Krone (NOK), the only market within the group carrying genuine FX exposure — trading its securities poses FX risk to euro-area investors, while no FX risk exists among the other six markets
fx_risk_note.detail: 属结构性推论（基于各国法定货币这一基础事实），非交易所自设规则，未附强quote。

political_risk_note.zh: 政治/监管风险具「多法域」两面性：一方面，七个市场分属多国监管，单一国家的政策冲击（如法国黄金权力审查、意大利新税）只局部影响，地理分散降低了单一主权风险；另一方面，集团受欧盟层面规则（MiFID II、EMIR、T+1 结算改革、MiFIR 修订）的统一牵引，欧盟级监管变动会同时波及全部市场，且跨市场整合（雅典迁移、CSD 整合）本身带来执行风险。
political_risk_note.en: The political/regulatory risk has a 'multi-jurisdiction' double edge: on one hand, the seven markets sit under several national regulators, so a policy shock in any single country (e.g. France's golden-power screening, Italy's new taxes) is only locally affecting, and geographic diversification lowers single-sovereign risk; on the other hand, the group is uniformly bound by EU-level rules (MiFID II, EMIR, the T+1 settlement reform, MiFIR review), so an EU-level regulatory change hits all markets at once, and the cross-market integration (Athens migration, CSD consolidation) itself carries execution risk.
political_risk_note.detail: 属结构性定性判断，非交易所自设规则；未附强 quote，confidence 标 medium。

liquidity_risk_note.zh: 整体流动性充足（Euronext 自称为欧洲最大流动性池），但流动性高度集中于 CAC 40/AEX/FTSE MIB 等旗舰指数成分股与大型蓝筹；Euronext Access/Growth 等中小市值板块、以及部分低流动性证券，买卖价差与冲击成本显著更高，存在结构性流动性分层风险。
liquidity_risk_note.en: Overall liquidity is ample (Euronext describes itself as the largest liquidity pool in Europe), but liquidity is highly concentrated in flagship-index constituents such as CAC 40, AEX and FTSE MIB and in large blue chips; on smaller-cap segments such as Euronext Access/Growth and on less-liquid names, bid-ask spreads and impact cost are materially higher, creating a structural liquidity-tiering risk.

regulatory_change_risk_note.zh: 正处于两项欧盟层面重大制度变革窗口期：（1）结算周期T+2→T+1（2027-10-11生效，见clearing.settlement_cycle）；（2）2025年新纳入的雅典市场尚未整合进统一规则手册与Optiq平台（计划2027-06完成），整合完成前雅典与其余七个市场在规则细节上仍不完全一致
regulatory_change_risk_note.en: Currently in a window of two major EU-level structural changes: (1) the settlement cycle move from T+2 to T+1 (effective 11 October 2027, see clearing.settlement_cycle); (2) the newly-added Athens market (2025) has not yet been integrated into the harmonised rulebook or Optiq (integration targeted for June 2027) — until completion, Athens' detailed rules remain not fully aligned with the other seven markets

regulatory_change_risk_note.quote: Euronext Athens markets are scheduled to be integrated in the Euronext rulebooks upon the migration to Optiq (June 2027).

enforcement_note.zh: 市场运营实体对会员违规拥有分级惩戒权：可要求整改、处以固定金额 Liquidated Damages（按公告级距 EUR 500 至 EUR 250.000）、暂停部分或全部交易/会员权利（最长六个月）、终止会员资格，并可公布处分决定；对发行人违规则依持续义务章节处理。若会员违规威胁市场公允有序，Euronext 可立即采取包括暂停其部分交易权在内的即时措施。
enforcement_note.en: The Market Undertaking has a graduated enforcement toolkit against member violations: it may require rectification, impose liquidated damages of a fixed amount (between EUR 500 and EUR 250.000 per a published scale), suspend some or all of a member's trading/membership rights (for no more than six months), terminate the member's Euronext Membership, and/or publish the decision; issuer violations are handled under the continuing-obligations chapter. Where a member's violation threatens a fair, orderly and efficient market, Euronext may take immediate measures including suspending some of the member's trading rights.

sources.title: Euronext Rule Book Book I - Harmonised Rules（Rule 9301/1 违规处分；Rule 9103 即时措施）

enforcement_note.quote: If a Rule has been violated, Euronext may: ... require from the Member liquidated damages for the violation of the Rule, of a fixed amount between EUR 500 and EUR 250.000 according to a scale published in a Notice; ... suspend some of the Member's trading or membership rights for no more than six months; ... terminate the Member's Euronext Membership; and/or publish all or part of the decision taken by Euronext under this Rule.
